pages: WIRING DIAGRAM Split System Air Conditioner (Outdoor Section) NOTES: 1. Disconnect all power before servicing. 2. For supply connections use copper conductors only. 3. For replacement wires use conductors suitable for 105 deg. C. 4. For supply wire ampacities and overcurrent protection, see unit rating plate. 5. Connect to 24 vac/40 va/class 2 circuit. See furnace/air handler installation instructions for control circuit and optional relay/transformer kits. Three Phase 1. Couper le courant avant de faire letretien. 2. Employez uniquement des conducteurs en cuivre.
